newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia allows banks to enter forward forex market.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia allows banks to enter forward forex market.

text.p: Tunisia, within the framework of the liberalisation of the foreign exchange market, will allow domestic banks to have forward foreign exchange operations, the Central Bank of Tunisia (BCT) said on Monday.

In a circular sent to the banks on Monday and obtained by Reuters, BCT says domestic banks were "allowed to make forward foreign exchange for their resident clients for their trade and services operations with non-residents..."
It said banks were authorised to rate currencies against the Tunisian dinar for a maximum 12 months for imports and nine months for exports.
It says the decision was to be implemented starting of June 30.
As to now, only a domestic interbank spot forex market established in 1994 was operational.
Earlier, a circular from the central bank said that domestic banks are now allowed to start exchanging hard currencies with foreign financial institutions.
